verdict.rationale: Docs confirm you can run the Customer Agent and Internal Agent via API (customer requests without a ticketing system, running automations from your own tools), giving some functional parity with the UI. However, the core configuration workflow (describing flows in natural language, approving releases, testing simulations, guardrails) is documented as happening through the Internal Agent conversational UI, with no evidence these config actions are exposed as API endpoints, and a probe for a public OpenAPI/swagger spec returned only 404s, suggesting incomplete or undiscoverable API surface. missing for 10: API endpoints for configuration/release/guardrail management, a discoverable OpenAPI spec, and independent confirmation of full UI-API parity.
